thread:
Priya (PMM): Quick design triage — we need a small asset bundle for next week's webinar + a benchmark landing hero for paid socials. Also a tiny diagram for inbound lead routing. Can design pick this up?
Jon (Design): Yep, can do. Need final hero copy + the headline metric for the benchmark. Who owns the metric verification?
Maya (Demand Gen): I have the benchmark CSV. Top-line stat we want to call out is '2.3x lower token cost vs baseline' — should we round or add a qualifier? Also request sizes: 16:9 hero, 1:1 social, 9:16 story.
Liam (Creative Ops): Noted. Also need brand-safe palette and a webinar thumbnail template (60px logo lockup). Any requirements on motion? (gif/mp4)
Priya (PMM): Use Brand Kit v3 (https://fig.ma/redwood/brand-kit-v3). CCing Alex for legal on phrasing. Deadline: first comps by Wednesday EOD so we can hand to ops.
Alex (Legal): Quick check: the '2.3x lower token cost' claim is ok as long as it includes the qualifier 'on our internal workload' or similar. Send me the supporting benchmark doc and I'll sign off. Also avoid naming competitors.
Jon (Design): Thanks — plan: 1) hero PNG for landing 16:9, 2) three social tiles (1:1) + story (9:16), 3) webinar thumbnail (small, static + optional animated), 4) one-pager PDF with benchmark chart. ETA Wed noon for first comps.
Maya (Demand Gen): For the lead-routing visual we need a micro-diagram: Signup form -> webhook -> OOTB processor -> CRM. Simple icons, annotated. Also include the CTA copy for the webinar: 'Register to see the full benchmark'.
Liam (Creative Ops): We have an existing diagram template in Figma: /files/diagram-templates (please reuse). Jon, can you drop variants and label components for reuse in landing pages?
Sam (Growth): @Maya I'll confirm the webhook and CRM field names today and paste into this thread. Also prefer 'Register to see the full benchmark' as the CTA.
DesignBot: New asset request logged: ART-4897. Owner: Jon (Design). Due date: 2026-03-25. Priority: High.
Priya (PMM): :thumbsup: Jon — when you upload frames, please include export specs: PNG 72dpi for web, SVG for icons, PDF 300dpi for one-pager. Name files like: webinar-hero_16x9.png, benchmark-tile_1x1.png, leadflow_diagram.svg.
Jon (Design): Quick question — for the benchmark chart, prefer stacked bars to show cost components or sparkline for trend? I lean toward stacked bars so we can call out cost breakdown.
Maya (Demand Gen): Stacked bars please. Add a callout bubble for 'KV-cache savings' next to the relevant bar.
Alex (Legal): I approve the phrasing with the qualifier (add 'on our internal workload'). Also confirm no competitor logos or trademarked icons.
Liam (Creative Ops): I'll slot this into creative queue as 'High — webinar' and add tags for launch and benchmark. Jon, I'll also prep the Figma export presets.
Priya (PMM): If anyone needs copy edits, ping me offline. Otherwise expect a first pass Wed noon. Thanks everyone — closing the loop here.
